recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration draft a review agenda for all its policies, guidelines, standard operating procedures and manuals. It is vital that all these regulations reflect the increasing implementation and significance of Umoja for all support and substantive United Nations processes. They should be accordingly corrected or amended if they do not.
